_comment: Editor UI metadata for LondonBreakout — labels, groups, descriptions, the 'essentials' (core) flag, conditional visibility (show_if), and toggle option labels. Consumed by the command-center scanner and overlaid onto the scanned param schema. Affects the lab UI only; never the compiled .ex5 or the source hash. Param order here is the canonical UI order. Top-level 'edge' and 'steps' drive the strategy-detail overview.
edge: Only trade days where the overnight range is neither too dead nor too wild, and let London's volatility expansion do the work. The Range filter decides which days qualify and the Profit target sets how hard each winner is pushed — that's where most of the tuning lives.

steps.label: 01 · Asian
steps.title: Measure the range
steps.detail: The 00:00–06:00 GMT high-low sets the day's reference band.

steps.label: 02 · Filter
steps.title: Is the day tradable?
steps.detail: Skip days whose range is too small (no fuel) or too large (already moved).

steps.label: 03 · London
steps.title: Trade the break
steps.detail: Enter on the breakout, target a multiple of risk, force-flat before close.

params.name: PendingEntry
params.label: Entry style
params.desc: How the breakout trade gets placed. Market enters at the close of the bar that breaks the range. Pending places stop orders at the breakout levels and fills when price touches them.

params.name: PipRangeFilter
params.label: Filter mode
params.desc: Which days are tradable, judged by the size of the Asian range. ATR band scales the size limits with each pair's own volatility. Fixed pips uses hard pip bounds that don't adapt.

params.name: RangeMinAtr
params.label: Min range
params.desc: Skip the day if the Asian range is smaller than this × daily ATR. Setting it too low lets lower-quality days through.
guide: More trades but lower-quality days get through

params.name: TargetRR
params.label: Profit target
params.desc: Take-profit as a multiple of the stop distance. 1.0 means reward equals risk.
guide: Aims for more per trade, but may not be reached before force-flat

params.name: BufferPips
params.label: Pending buffer
params.desc: How far beyond the range the pending stop sits. Only used with pending entry.

params.name: RangeMaxAtr
params.label: Max range
params.desc: Skip the day if the Asian range is larger than this × daily ATR.

params.name: RangeMinPips
params.label: Min range
params.desc: Reject the day if the Asian range is below this many pips.
guide: More trades but lower-quality days get through

params.name: RangeMaxPips
params.label: Max range
params.desc: Reject the day if the Asian range is above this many pips.

params.name: SweetMinPips
params.label: Sweet spot low
params.desc: Logged only, never a gate — tracks how many qualifying days landed in the sweet spot.

params.name: BufferAtr
params.label: Breakout buffer
params.desc: How far beyond the range price must travel to trigger an entry (ATR entry mode).
guide: Needs a bigger break to enter

params.name: AtrPeriod
params.label: ATR lookback
params.desc: Daily ATR window used to scale the range band and the breakout buffer.

params.name: BreakEvenMove
params.label: Break-even stop
params.desc: Move the stop to entry once price reaches +1R, taking risk off the trade.

params.name: AsianStartGMT
params.label: Asian range start
params.desc: Start of the quiet Asian window that sets the reference range. GMT, auto DST-adjusted.

params.name: AsianEndGMT
params.label: Asian range end
params.desc: End of the Asian window (exclusive). GMT, auto DST-adjusted.

params.name: LondonOpenGMT
params.label: London watch start
params.desc: When the strategy starts watching for the breakout. GMT, auto DST-adjusted.

params.name: EntryCutoffGMT
params.label: Entry cutoff
params.desc: Last bar an entry may be taken on (exclusive). GMT, auto DST-adjusted.

params.name: ForceFlatGMT
params.label: Force-flat
params.desc: Any open trade is closed at or after this time. GMT, auto DST-adjusted.
